faqs.q: What is the difference between content marketing and SEO?
faqs.a: They are two halves of the same job. SEO makes sure Google can find, understand, and trust your site. Content marketing gives Google something worth ranking: pages that answer real customer questions. I do both together, because content without SEO is invisible and SEO without content has nothing to rank.

faqs.q: How many blog posts do I need per month?
faqs.a: Fewer than you think, and better than you expect. I do not sell post quotas, because quotas produce filler. Most Nottingham businesses I work with publish a handful of genuinely useful pages per quarter, each targeting searches with real buying intent, and outperform competitors publishing weekly fluff.

faqs.q: Will content marketing work for my industry in Nottingham?
faqs.a: If your customers search before they buy, yes. That covers most local services, hospitality around the Lace Market and Hockley, professional firms, and trades. If nobody ever Googles what you do, I will tell you honestly and suggest where your budget is better spent.

faqs.q: How long until content starts bringing customers?
faqs.a: Expect early traction in three to four months and compounding returns after six. Content is slower than ads and far more durable: a page that ranks keeps working for years without another penny of ad spend.
